description: The first step for a design from scratch, such as a pump: find what to build it from: blocks with inputs, placement and an example call, general operations, and similar designs (built: all a finished one has). Give the brief, or one shape or job at a time ("tapered passage"). Set introduction=true on the first call to read how a document is written and what every block is for. No match is no reason to refuse or to use the nearest template: build from operations.

introduction.description: Also return how a design document is written and what every block is for. Ask once.

limit.description: The most blocks, and the most operations, to describe.

text.description: A brief, or words for one shape or job.
